description: The Bataviawerf harbour at Museum Batavialand shows the museum sheds and the quay lamps over a calm basin. The wooden Batavia replica is not in this picture: it left Lelystad on 19 September 2026 for a dry dock in Amsterdam and is scheduled to return on a pontoon on 1 October. The sky is mainly clear, about 14.8°C, with wind near 9.0 km/h and no rain. Sunset was 19:27.
